payload.title: FVG_CONT identity / variant contamination map before any economic claim

parent_decision.note: LIQ_SWEEP confirmatory closed; attention moves to next shortlist item per EDGE_CREDIT_SAFE_OPERATING_LOOP_V1 and phase7_26 FVG_CONT_INTEGRITY_AUDIT

payload.question: Before any edge claim on FVG_CONT: (1) is the canonical MQL5 FVG_CONT path identity-distinct from IFVG / FVG_MIT / FVG_MIT_WINDOW despite shared STRAT_FVG_CONT enum? (2) can selector=8 isolation measure ONLY NXS_Strat_FVG without variant contamination? (3) is there CROSS_TIMEFRAME_STATE_CONTAMINATION risk on the canonical path or only on variants? (4) does Python backtest measure the same exit recipe as MQL5?

A_STATIC_IDENTITY_MAP.definition: Code-only map of function, selector, stratName, TF profile, state, exits for FVG_CONT + variants.

B_ISOLATION_FEASIBILITY.definition: Determine whether InpStrategySelector=8 + ResearchMode harness yields trades attributable only to stratName FVG_CONT.

C_PYTHON_PARITY_FLAGS.definition: Flag entry/exit mismatches vs server/backtest.py that would invalidate PF reuse.

decision_rule_frozen.ISOLATION_READY: Canonical FVG_CONT is a separate function gated by selector 8; variants use different selectors/functions; no persistent state on canonical path; Python economic reuse forbidden if exit mismatch flagged — next step is MT5 isolation diagnostic under a NEW prereg.
decision_rule_frozen.VARIANT_CONTAMINATION_BLOCKS_ISOLATION: Selector 8 or shared state causes non-FVG_CONT stratNames / shared persistent state to affect the canonical path — fix or redesign isolation before any diagnostic run.
decision_rule_frozen.CTF_DEFECT_ON_CANONICAL: Canonical NXS_Strat_FVG has CROSS_TIMEFRAME_STATE_CONTAMINATION — remediate before edge work.
decision_rule_frozen.MIXED_NEEDS_HUMAN: Any other pattern; no promotion; no live.

data_policy.next_phase_requires: If decision=ISOLATION_READY: commit a separate MT5 diagnostic prereg, then run selector=8 isolation on research PC (same harness as LIQ_SWEEP). Do not reuse LIQ_SWEEP short forward window expectations — size window for power / trade density first.

payload.power_note: This phase makes NO edge claim and needs no trade sample. Any later FVG_CONT edge prereg must pass Power Gate / Edge Detection Capability sizing before confirmatory claims. LIQ_SWEEP 7.30 showed ~3-week H4 windows can yield n=0 — do not repeat undersized confirmatory windows.
explicit_non_goals: No MQL5 live flag changes in this phase
